description: This file contains Python code for parsing YAML files, extracting properties with comments, and checking for missing descriptions. It includes functions for reading YAML lines, parsing hierarchical keys, and validating property comments.

methods.name: extract_properties_with_comments
methods.description: Reads a YAML file and extracts properties along with comments, maintaining hierarchical structure.

methods.name: parse_line
methods.description: Recursively parses lines of a YAML file to build a map of keys and associated comments.

methods.name: extract_property_info
methods.description: Processes extracted properties to identify environment variables, default values, and comments.

methods.name: check_descriptions
methods.description: Checks for properties lacking sufficient descriptive comments.

methods.name: check_yml
methods.description: Main function to parse a YAML file, extract property info, and validate descriptions.
